textPrompt: Create an exceptionally professional, visually stunning 12-slide corporate stakeholder presentation for a fictional premium automotive company named 'CONFORT AUTOMOBILES', with the brand tagline 'Le Confort en Mouvement' (Comfort in Motion). The company specializes in designing and selling elegant, comfortable, technologically advanced luxury vehicles, including premium sedans, SUVs, and electric vehicles. The purpose of the presentation is to introduce the company to investors, shareholders, strategic partners, and other stakeholders, communicate its business vision, showcase its automotive portfolio, explain its market opportunity and growth strategy, and establish confidence in its long-term potential. STRUCTURE: Slide 1: Premium title slide with the company name, tagline, and a spectacular full-bleed photograph of an elegant luxury vehicle. Slide 2: Executive summary presenting the company's vision, value proposition, and strategic priorities. Slide 3: Company overview, brand identity, mission, and commitment to comfort, engineering, and innovation. Slide 4: Market opportunity and industry trends, including luxury mobility, vehicle electrification, and evolving customer expectations. Slide 5: Product portfolio showcasing three fictional vehicle concepts: CONFORT Élégance (premium sedan), CONFORT Prestige (luxury SUV), and CONFORT Électrique (electric vehicle), with distinct, beautiful automotive images. Slide 6: Competitive positioning, highlighting comfort, design, safety, technology, and customer experience. Slide 7: Technology and innovation, covering advanced driver-assistance systems, intelligent cabin technology, connectivity, and electric powertrain development. Slide 8: Business model and revenue streams, including vehicle sales, fleet partnerships, after-sales services, and potential subscription services. Slide 9: Go-to-market strategy, covering customer acquisition, dealership partnerships, digital sales, and brand positioning. Slide 10: Financial outlook and investment priorities, using clearly labeled illustrative financial projections rather than invented historical company results. Slide 11: Three-year strategic roadmap with product development, market entry, partnership development, and expansion milestones. Slide 12: Closing stakeholder message highlighting the company's ambition, investment proposition, and future of premium mobility. CRITICAL IMAGE REQUIREMENTS: Every slide must feature at least one real, high-quality, visually relevant image embedded directly into the PowerPoint. Use sophisticated automotive photography, elegant vehicle exteriors, premium leather interiors, modern dashboards, electric vehicle technology, automotive manufacturing environments, and luxury driving experiences. Use varied and beautiful images throughout the presentation. For fictional CONFORT vehicle concepts, use appropriately labeled concept imagery rather than pretending photographs depict actual manufactured CONFORT models. Never substitute pictures with empty placeholders, generic shapes, gradients, or icons. All images must be physically embedded in the PPTX and visible in PDF and PNG previews. DESIGN DIRECTION: Create a premium European automotive aesthetic inspired by sophisticated luxury car brand presentations, without copying any specific brand's identity. Use a refined palette of midnight navy, charcoal black, champagne gold, ivory, and metallic silver. Employ elegant modern typography, cinematic full-width car photography, split-screen layouts, premium editorial compositions, sophisticated charts, clean financial tables, attractive product comparison layouts, and polished infographics. Ensure every slide has strong visual hierarchy, readable text, appropriate spacing, excellent contrast, and professional composition. Keep the presentation concise, credible, and suitable for a boardroom or investor meeting. Do not invent real sales figures, customers, market statistics, partnerships, achievements, or investment returns. Label assumptions and hypothetical projections clearly. The final presentation should be a polished, image-rich, investor-ready corporate PowerPoint that demonstrates exceptional automotive photography, premium branding, and stakeholder communication.
